title: carludovica humilis
intro: Carludovica humilis, commonly known as the "Guadua palm", is a type of flowering plant in the family Arecaceae. It is native to Central America, particularly in Mexico and Guatemala. The health benefits of Carludovica humilis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and prevent infections.
